files.Title: EvoSim.ActContext
files.Summary: What an action may do in one tick (ACT-06): ask questions about what the animal could sense, and say where it wants to go (an intent) and what to do on arrival (an interaction). It can't move or change any animal itself.

files.Title: EvoSim.ActOrder
files.Summary: The order in which animals act within a tick (ACT-30).

files.Title: EvoSim.ActPhase
files.Summary: Every living animal acts, in the act order (ACT-30): its action plans an intent and an interaction, its species' locomotion moves it, interactions apply within reach, then its metabolism is paid and busy counters drop (TICK-04 #4, ANIM-20, ANIM-30).

files.Title: EvoSim.ActPlan
files.Summary: One animal's plan for a tick (): what writes for each animal of its group, and what the act phase then moves and applies.

files.Title: EvoSim.ActionColors
files.Summary: One colour per action name, shared by the views and the overlay's legend. Actions it doesn't know get a colour from their name's characters (the same on every run; no random numbers, RAND-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.ActionView
files.Summary: The reference body's view (20 §6): a marker above the head in the colour of the animal's action (), and a body that darkens as its energy drops. It only reads the animal (SPACE-12). Copy it to show something else: override and read what you need.

files.Title: EvoSim.AgeSense
files.Summary: Young or adult (06 §4): adult from the maturity trait (ANIM-36), reference 150 ticks.

files.Title: EvoSim.Allele
files.Summary: One registered allele with its lineage (GENE-11, GENE-12): one version of a gene, such as the sentence "Rest when you are tired." at the prey's rest gene, or the number 60 at a stamina gene.

files.Title: EvoSim.AlleleKind
files.Summary: What kind of value a gene holds (GENE-02): a sentence or a number.

files.Title: EvoSim.AllelePool
files.Summary: Founder and contrast sentences shared by several text genes, as an asset (GENE-24, 20 §3.8).

files.Title: EvoSim.AlleleRegistry
files.Summary: Every allele seen in a run, once per (locus, value) (GENE-10), with ids "<locus>:<n>" (GENE-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.AlleleValue
files.Summary: One allele value: a sentence or a number.

files.Title: EvoSim.Animal
files.Summary: One animal: plain data owned by its species (ANIM-01, ARCH-03). Modules read and write it through this record.

files.Title: EvoSim.AnimalAction
files.Summary: A behaviour the brain can choose (ACT-01). Each tick it gives an intent and maybe an interaction; it never moves anything itself.

files.Title: EvoSim.AnimalHit
files.Summary: An animal found by a spatial query, with its distance from the asker (SPACE-07).

files.Title: EvoSim.AnimalSet
files.Summary: A set of species resolved from the food web (SPEC-12): whom an animal flees, hunts or follows.

files.Title: EvoSim.AnimalView
files.Summary: One animal's view (20 §6): it holds only the animal's id and has no Update; the World places it in LateUpdate and never reads it back (SPACE-12).

files.Title: EvoSim.AnimalWords
files.Summary: Common animal words, for the stale-name check V-23 (SPEC-21): a founder sentence naming one of them that is no species of the world was probably written for another world, or before a rename.

files.Title: EvoSim.AnswerCache
files.Summary: A persistent store of brain and mutator answers (DEC-33, MUT-14): append-only JSON lines, one file per brain, loaded at the first lookup. Keys hash everything that can change an answer, so a repeated run replays without model calls (RAND-21). Rows are stored with round-trip precision, so a replay is bit-identical.

files.Title: EvoSim.AskBrainsPhase
files.Summary: Builds each deciding animal's query (DEC-10), answers it from the memo (DEC-30) or the answer cache (DEC-33), sends the rest as one batch per brain — per species for brains that can't mix species — with identical keys sent once (DEC-13, DEC-15, DEC-32). Nothing in the world changes here (CORE-06).

files.Title: EvoSim.BandedSense
files.Summary: A sense that reports how far the nearest something is, in bands (06 §3): "here" (optional), the bands, "none". Wording (SENSE-10…13): V1 "Food: 1-4 meters away." / V2 "The nearest food is 1-4 meters away.".

files.Title: EvoSim.Bands
files.Summary: Distance bands (06 §3, SENSE-20): increasing edges e1 < … < ek and a vision v > ek. A distance falls in the first band with d ≤ ei, in "far" if ek < d ≤ v, and is "none" beyond v. Reference: 1, 4, 10 m and 20 m.

files.Title: EvoSim.Batch
files.Summary: Headless runs (30 §6, 31 §1, 32 §4): Unity -batchmode -executeMethod EvoSim.Batch.RunScenario -scenario S03 [-variant name] [-seed n] [-ticks n] [-responsive]. In the open editor the same runs go through RunScenarioNamed (the unity CLI's eval). Worlds run in Freeze mode, outside Play mode: the World initialises itself (ARCH-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.BatchedSense
files.Summary: A sense that casts rays (line of sight, terrain ahead): it asks for its rays first; the sense phase casts the rays of all deciding animals in one batch, then each sense reads its results (SENSE-30). It must give the same tokens as evaluating it one animal at a time (SENSE-31).

files.Title: EvoSim.Body
files.Summary: What a species' animals look like (20 §6): a view prefab, or a placeholder capsule of a colour. Views only read the simulation (SPACE-12); a species without a Body runs unseen.

files.Title: EvoSim.Brain
files.Summary: Maps a batch of queries to probability rows over the species' actions (DEC-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.BrainAnswer
files.Summary: A brain's answer to a batch (DEC-11): one probability row per query, in query order, or a failure per query. Fast brains fill it at once; HTTP brains later, from another thread, then mark it done.

files.Title: EvoSim.BrainRequest
files.Summary: One decision query as an HTTP brain sends it: its place in the batch, the text for the model and the species' action names. builds it on the main thread; reads it on the thread pool, so it holds plain values only, no Unity object.

files.Title: EvoSim.BreedPhase
files.Summary: After all animals acted (TICK-06): each ready animal that chose mate and hasn't bred this period breeds with the nearest ready partner within reach that hasn't bred either — one partner's choice is enough (REPRO-02, REPRO-03). A litter is conceived (REPRO-10, REPRO-11): one egg per baby with its own crossover and its mutations drawn now (GENE-32, MUT-30); the LLM mutations are sent as one batch at the end (MUT-31).

files.Title: EvoSim.CanonicalJson
files.Summary: Writes JSON with sorted keys and fixed number formatting, so equal data gives equal text (RAND-10). Separators follow Python's json.dumps defaults (", " and ": "), the prototype's format.

files.Title: EvoSim.CapRule.Mode
files.Summary: How the cap is kept (POP-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.CapRule
files.Summary: The maximum population of a species (POP-01). Migrate (reference): births go on, and above the cap random older animals leave the world. Block: no conception at the cap, litters cut to the places left.

files.Title: EvoSim.Carcass
files.Summary: What a kill leaves (03 §3): a few portions that other eaters may eat, one portion each, never the killer. It rots away when its lifetime runs out, eaten or not, and goes as soon as its last portion is eaten (ENV-22).

files.Title: EvoSim.CarcassSystem
files.Summary: Carcasses, as each species' edible component describes them: portions, energy, lifetime (03 §3). A carcass of a species is edible when that species' Edible leaves one; diets name it "carcass:<species>".

files.Title: EvoSim.CellGrid
files.Summary: A grid of square cells over the world rectangle, used inside layers (food cells, cover cells) — never to place animals (02 intro). Finds the nearest marked cell by expanding rings (20 §9).

files.Title: EvoSim.ChooseActionsPhase
files.Summary: Waits for the brains (TICK-03), stores fresh answers in the memo and the cache (never a failure, DEC-34), and draws each deciding animal's action with its species' sampling stream after the temperature (DEC-20, RAND-03). A failed answer stops a strict run cleanly; otherwise it becomes a uniform row and is counted (DEC-40).

files.Title: EvoSim.ContactSheet
files.Summary: A grid of a folder's PNG captures, scaled down on the GPU, saved as contact_sheet.png.

files.Title: EvoSim.Cover
files.Summary: Places where an animal is hidden from the species that hunt it (03 §2). Optional: a world without one behaves as if no point were in cover (ENV-12).

files.Title: EvoSim.CoverHit
files.Summary: The nearest cover found by a query: a point in cover and its distance (ENV-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.CoverLayer
files.Summary: Cover in clustered patches (thickets): the top of walkable cells of a value-noise map, drawn from the world stream (03 §2 reference: 20 %, octaves 8 and 4 m).

files.Title: EvoSim.Crossover
files.Summary: Builds a baby's genome from its parents', locus by locus (09 §4). Genomes never cross species (SPEC-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.DeathPhase
files.Summary: Removes killed animals; every living animal ages by one tick (babies of this tick included); then each species' death rules (starvation, old age…) in module order. Every death is recorded once (TICK-04 #7, ANIM-35, ANIM-40…43).

files.Title: EvoSim.DeathRule
files.Summary: A cause of death checked in the death phase (ANIM-40): return the cause's name, or null to live on.

files.Title: EvoSim.Decision
files.Summary: One animal deciding this tick: what it sensed, what its brain was asked and answered (08 §1–§5).

files.Title: EvoSim.DecisionMemo
files.Summary: Within a run, the answer for a key (species, brain, brain-visible genome key, observation) is computed once and reused (DEC-30). A hit gives exactly what the brain answered. Failed answers are never stored (DEC-34). Keys are kept as 128-bit hashes and identical rows are shared, so a long run's memo stays small (R-06).

files.Title: EvoSim.DecisionQuery
files.Summary: What a brain receives for one deciding animal (DEC-10): its species, the genes its brain reads (label and sentence, in locus order), its observation, its situation text in the world's style, and any attachments.

files.Title: EvoSim.DecisionSchedule
files.Summary: A species' own decision period, and staggering (DEC-04, MAY): an animal decides when (tick + id) % period == 0. Both change behaviour. In the reference scenes every species has one, staggered, with the World's period (owner 2026-10-10); a species without one decides all together, every World period, as the Python prototype does.

files.Title: EvoSim.DecisionState
files.Summary: The decisions of the current tick, the brain answers they wait for, and the run's memo (08 §1–§4).

files.Title: EvoSim.Diet.Entry
files.Summary: One line of the diet: what is eaten, and how much its energy is scaled (SPEC-15).

files.Title: EvoSim.Diet
files.Summary: What a species eats (SPEC-15): layers, species, "carcass:<species>", "egg:<species>". Each target must carry an Edible (SPEC-10, V-24). A species with no diet eats nothing.

files.Title: EvoSim.Digestion
files.Summary: After a kill or a carcass portion the eater is busy digesting for round(digestTicks × gain / killGain) ticks: 50 after a kill (+60), 25 after a portion (+30). Grazing never makes an animal busy (05 §5).

files.Title: EvoSim.EatAction
files.Summary: Go to the nearest visible food and eat it (07 §4). Nothing in sight: search (ACT-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.EatMethod
files.Summary: How something edible is eaten (SPEC-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.Edible
files.Summary: Makes what it sits on edible (SPEC-10): a species' animals, a resource layer's items, an entity kind. Without it nothing can eat that thing, whatever the diets say (ENV-23).

files.Title: EvoSim.EdibleTarget
files.Summary: One resolved diet entry: what is eaten, how (its Edible), and the energy scale (SPEC-15).

files.Title: EvoSim.EdibleTargetKind
files.Summary: What a diet entry points at (SPEC-15).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.AnimalInspectorWindow
files.Summary: The selected animal (21 §4, lab C): stats, traits, genome sentences, last situation, last probabilities as bars, current action and target, busy reason, parents and offspring. Click an animal's view to select it.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.AskTheBrainWindow
files.Summary: Ask the brain (21 §4, labs C and I): build a genome (founders, edited sentences, a gene's contrast pair, control sentences), pick a situation, and ask several brains side by side; a directed test asks with a gene's pro sentence, then with its anti one, so P(action) can be compared. Queries are built from texts only: nothing is registered in the world, so asking never changes a run.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.BrainHealthWindow
files.Summary: Brain health (21 §4): every brain and mutator client of the current world with its host, a Test connection button (V-60, on demand), model and revision or digest, latency, failures, and the answer cache's size and hits.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.EcologyMonitorWindow
files.Summary: The ecology monitor (21 §4, labs A and B): population per species over time, deaths by cause, births, action shares, memo hit rate, ticks per second — from LiveStatistics and the species counters.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.EditorWorlds
files.Summary: What the windows look at (EDIT-05): the worlds of the open scenes, the selected world, the selected animal.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.EventLogWindow
files.Summary: The event log (21 §4, lab D): the running world's events as they are recorded, filtered by kind, species and animal; following an animal shows its line and its descendants' births.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.EvoSimOverlay
files.Summary: The scene-view overlay (21 §5): toggles for food, cover, carcasses, eggs and action letters, and species filters.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.Exercises
files.Summary: EvoSim ▸ Exercises (21 §6, 22 §0): Replace with stub writes the student stub of a reference module into Assets/Student and swaps the module for it in the open scenes, keeping its settings; Restore reference undoes it.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.FoodWebWindow
files.Summary: The food web (21 §4): species and layers as a graph with graze, strike, scavenge and egg edges, the derived threats, and the food-web warnings of validation.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.GenePoolWindow
files.Summary: The gene pool (21 §4, labs D and E): per locus, the allele shares among the living over time (stacked), the current top alleles with their text and origin, and the lineage of a selected allele as a chain of texts; number genes as histograms of the living animals' values.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.PlayModeGate
files.Summary: EDIT-01: before Play, every enabled World in the open scenes is validated with the same engine as World.Initialize; errors cancel Play and are logged with the object at fault (EDIT-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.PromptPreview
files.Summary: The species inspector's prompt preview (21 §3, PROMPT-06): built by the same code as the Ask brains phase, so it is exactly what the brain receives — for JEV, its whole input text (T-PROMPT-05).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.RealTimeRuns
files.Summary:
The real-time visual test from the unity CLI (eval): a headless reference run, a scene set up for Play mode, and the run's status while it plays. Levels: L0 the random brain and no mutation (offline), L1 the scene's brain (JEV) and no mutation, L2 the scene's brain and mutator. Example:

unity command eval --code 'return EvoSim.Editor.RealTimeRuns.Headless("HideVsFlee", 1234, 600, "L2", "RT-L2-headless");'

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.ReferenceScenes
files.Summary: Builds the reference content (20 §2, §7; 09 §3): the allele pools from the prototype's pool files, the module prefabs (Modules/), placeholder bodies, and the scenes Lab1_Small, Lab1_Full, HideVsFlee, ThreeSpecies, Terrain_Locomotion and Sandbox. The scenes are then the configuration (ARCH-01): edit them, not this builder, unless the reference itself changes. Scenes are opened additively from an empty file, so the editor's own open scene is never touched.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.RunViews
files.Summary: Makes a scene watchable (20 §6): a "Run views" object with the ground, entity markers, overlay and capture, and a on the main camera; and the reference bodies (a capsule standing on the ground, a nose that shows where it goes, a marker in the colour of its action). All of them only read the World (SPACE-12).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.ScenarioRunnerWindow
files.Summary: The scenario runner (21 §4, lab G): the scenario assets, a variant, seeds and length; runs them headless (Freeze, the same code as EvoSim.Batch.RunScenario) and lists the results; "twice" checks the reproducibility fact.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.SceneDrawing
files.Summary: The scene view (21 §5): gizmos for the selected animal (vision, a line to its target, a 1 m circle coloured by action) and, as the overlay's toggles say, food items, cover, carcasses, eggs and a letter per action above each animal (stable colours from the action order). Drawing only reads the world (SPACE-12).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.ScriptTemplates
files.Summary: Assets ▸ Create ▸ EvoSim (21 §6): script templates for a new sense, action, gene kind, stat, phase, brain or mutation operator — each with the methods to override and a matching test — and a mutation deck. Scripts go to Assets/Student (with its assembly), tests to Assets/Student/Tests (with a test assembly that sees EvoSim.Testing).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.SpeciesInspector
files.Summary: The Species inspector (21 §3, EDIT-04): read-only tables computed from the subtree (actions, senses, genes, stats and traits, food, population), the observation-space size, the signature, and a prompt preview built by the same code as the Ask brains phase (T-PROMPT-05).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.ValidationPanel
files.Summary: The validation list of the inspectors (EDIT-01, EDIT-02): one line per message with its severity, a button that selects the object at fault, and the fix button when the validator offers one.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.VisualPlayerBuild
files.Summary: Builds a Windows player that draws a run (07 real-time test): Windows 64-bit, Mono, the reference scenes (HideVsFlee first) given here, not in the Build Settings, into Builds/EvoSim/<date>/EvoSim.exe. Project and Player settings are left as they are. Batch: -executeMethod EvoSim.Editor.VisualPlayerBuild.BuildFromCommandLine [-scenes HideVsFlee,Lab1_Full] [-out folder]. Run it: EvoSim.exe -scene HideVsFlee -seed 1234 -ticks 600 -speed 5 -brain JEV -capture 10 -quitAtEnd -screen-fullscreen 0 -logFile player.log (PlayerArgs).

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.WorldFactory
files.Summary: Creating things from the menus (21 §6): a new world with the default tree, a new species with the reference body modules, and actions, senses and genes from the module prefabs in Modules/. The static methods are what the menus call, so tests build worlds exactly as a student does.

files.Title: EvoSim.Editor.WorldInspector
files.Summary: The World inspector (21 §3): state and tick, run controls in Play mode, the settings, the phases in order with their enable toggles, the services, and the validation panel.

files.Title: EvoSim.Egg
files.Summary: A conceived baby waiting to hatch (REPRO-20): its parents, generation, genome after crossover, the mutations still running, and when it hatches. Not an animal: it doesn't sense, decide, move or count toward caps (REPRO-22).

files.Title: EvoSim.EggMutation
files.Summary: One pending mutation of an egg: the locus, the inherited allele, the operator and its job (MUT-30).

files.Title: EvoSim.EggSystem
files.Summary: Eggs as entities (REPRO-20). In the reference they have no Edible, so nothing eats them (owner decision); an Edible on this GameObject and a diet entry "egg:<species>" make them food (22 §15).

files.Title: EvoSim.Energy
files.Summary: The energy stat (05 §4): founders and newcomers start at 60, the maximum is 100. Gains are clamped (ANIM-22).

files.Title: EvoSim.Entity
files.Summary: A world object with a position that is not an animal: a carcass, an egg, a water hole (ENV-20).

files.Title: EvoSim.EntityHit<T>
files.Summary: An entity found by a spatial query, with its distance (ENV-20).

files.Title: EvoSim.EntityKind
files.Summary: A kind of entity and its system (ENV-20): carcasses, eggs. Diets name it "<kind>:<species>".

files.Title: EvoSim.EntityMarkers
files.Summary: Small markers for the World's entities (ENV-20): a dark red disc per carcass, an ivory ball per egg, a grey cube for any other kind. Pooled primitives, placed each frame from the entity systems; they only read the World (SPACE-12): no collider, the Ignore Raycast layer.

files.Title: EvoSim.EntitySystem<T>
files.Summary: The entities of one kind, found through spatial queries like animals (ENV-20).

files.Title: EvoSim.EnvironmentPhase
files.Summary: Resource layers regrow, each with its own stream; entities move, rot or vanish (TICK-04 #9, ENV-03, ENV-22).

files.Title: EvoSim.EventLog
files.Summary: The world's events and their running hash (RAND-10). The hash is chained: h0 = SHA-256 of the seeds, h(i) = SHA-256(h(i-1) ‖ UTF-8(line i)), so it can be read after any event.

files.Title: EvoSim.ExerciseOfAttribute
files.Summary: Marks a student class as the exercise version of a reference module (22 §0, the teaching path): EvoSim ▸ Exercises ▸ Replace with stub swaps the reference for it, keeping the settings; Restore reference undoes it.

files.Title: EvoSim.Expression
files.Summary: What a gene expresses into (GENE-03/04): a trait of the animal being born, or a line of the prompt. receives one and calls or .

files.Title: EvoSim.FieldPath
files.Summary: Reads and overrides any serialized setting by path (CFG-02): "<GameObject path>/<Component>/<field>", relative to the World, e.g. "Prey/Litter/max", "World/decisionPeriod", "prey/Actions/flee/FleeAction/fleeIntoCover". Names are matched without case; a component is found by its class or a base class, on the GameObject or below it.

files.Title: EvoSim.FlatGround
files.Summary: The Lab 1 ground: a flat rectangle at height 0, walkable everywhere inside (02 §1).

files.Title: EvoSim.FleeAction
files.Summary: Run away from the nearest threat (07 §4). The prototype's "flee into cover" is an option, off in the reference: already in cover, stay; cover within coverSeek, run into it.

files.Title: EvoSim.FloorPhase
files.Summary: While a species has fewer animals than its floor, a newcomer arrives (POP-03); it decides at the next tick (TICK-05).

files.Title: EvoSim.FloorRule
files.Summary: The minimum population (POP-03): below it, newcomers with founder genomes arrive at random walkable places in the floor phase. A world that needs them is reported (POP-05): they restart that species' evolution.

files.Title: EvoSim.FollowAction
files.Summary: Walk toward the nearest other animal of the species, stopping at 1 m (07 §4).

files.Title: EvoSim.FoodGrid
files.Summary: The Lab 1 food layer (03 §1): at most one item per cell, at the cell centre; a share of walkable cells starts with an item; empty cells regrow at random, uniformly; no food in cover ("hungry cover", ENV-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.FounderAllele
files.Summary: One value of a founder pool and its origin (founder, neutral, control…) (GENE-20).

files.Title: EvoSim.GaussianMutation
files.Summary: The reference operator for number genes (MUT-20): v' = clamp(v + N(0, σ)) to the gene's range.

files.Title: EvoSim.Gene
files.Summary: A gene (locus) of a species: a sentence for the brain or a number for a trait (GENE-01…04). Each animal carries one allele (one value) of every gene of its species.

files.Title: EvoSim.Genome
files.Summary: One allele per locus of a species, in the species' locus order (GENE-06): the genes of one animal.

files.Title: EvoSim.Ground
files.Summary: Answers, for any point, its height and whether it is walkable (SPACE-04), inside a bounded rectangle with hard borders (SPACE-03). It also owns the world's distance function (SPACE-02): every module measures through it.

files.Title: EvoSim.GroundView
files.Summary: Draws a flat world's ground (02 §1) with its cover cells and food items (03 §1–2): one quad the size of the ground and a texture of one pixel per cell, repainted when a tick changed a cell. It only reads the World (SPACE-12): no collider, the Ignore Raycast layer, no random numbers.

files.Title: EvoSim.Hashing
files.Summary: SHA-256 helpers for keys, signatures and prompt ids. Pure functions, no state.

files.Title: EvoSim.HatchPhase
files.Summary: Eggs due this tick hatch, in conception order (REPRO-22), once their genome is complete: the tick waits for the mutator if its answers aren't in (MUT-32, REPRO-24). Each baby starts with the child energy, full stamina, age 0, at its first parent's position (REPRO-12), and a birth event records its litter and mutations (MUT-03).

files.Title: EvoSim.HideAction
files.Summary: Go to the nearest cover and stay in it (07 §4, ENV-13). No cover in sight, or no cover module: search.

files.Title: EvoSim.HttpBrain
files.Summary: The base of the brains that ask a model server over HTTP (08 §6): it turns a batch of queries into requests, sends them off the main thread and fills the when the answers come back.

files.Title: EvoSim.HttpCaller
files.Summary: JSON calls to one server with the reference client behaviour (DEC-42): a time-out per try, tries with doubling waits between them, a cap on requests in flight. The API key is read from its environment variable at each call and only sent, never stored or logged (OUT-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.HttpChecks
files.Summary: Checks shared by HTTP brains and mutator clients (the key checks, V-61, are ).

files.Title: EvoSim.HttpFailure
files.Summary: An HTTP call that failed: an error status, or every try used (DEC-40, DEC-42). Messages never hold keys (OUT-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.HttpMutatorClient
files.Summary: A mutator model behind a server (10 §2): one chat call per request with the prompt alone (CORE-07, MUT-11), the request's seed and temperature, thinking off. Calls run on the thread pool and fill the reply; the MutatorService caches answers and batches rounds (MUT-14, MUT-31).

files.Title: EvoSim.HttpStats
files.Summary: What a brain's or mutator's HTTP calls did: tries, retries, failures, latencies (B-01, brain health window).

files.Title: EvoSim.HuntAction
files.Summary: Chase the nearer of the nearest huntable animal and the nearest carcass it may eat (a carcass wins a tie, being a sure meal); strike the animal or eat from the carcass on arrival (07 §4).

files.Title: EvoSim.IEventSink
files.Summary: Receives every recorded event with its canonical line (OUT-06): the run recorder, live graphs, tests.

files.Title: EvoSim.IHttpTransport
files.Summary: Sends one HTTP request and returns the response body; throws HttpFailure for an error status. The real one is SystemHttpTransport; tests inject a fake (30 §2) so brains and mutators are tested without servers.

files.Title: EvoSim.IInteraction
files.Summary: A custom contact effect (22 §3, drink): applied after moving when the animal is within of the point its action walked or ran to (ACT-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.INumberRange
files.Summary: A gene whose values are numbers within a range: what number operators (Gaussian, MUT-20) and the random-founders control (CTRL-01) need, so a student's own number gene kind works with them.

files.Title: EvoSim.IStatsColumns
files.Summary: A module that adds columns to stats.csv (13 §4). A species module's columns get its species' prefix and hold that species' values; a world module's columns go at the end of the row, unprefixed. A new column during the run rewrites the header, with empty cells in the rows before it.

files.Title: EvoSim.Incubation
files.Summary: Ticks between conception and hatching (REPRO-20, REPRO-21): 0 in the reference (babies hatch the same tick); a few ticks hide the mutator's latency (MUT-33).

files.Title: EvoSim.Integrity
files.Summary: Brain and mutator integrity checks against the real servers (32 §2): B-01 smoke and B-11 blindness here, the gates B-02 to B-10 in . Command line: -executeMethod EvoSim.Integrity.RunIntegrity [-checks B-01,B-11] [-scene path] [-brain JEV]; in the open editor: Integrity.RunNamed through the unity CLI's eval.

files.Title: EvoSim.IntegrityGates
files.Summary: The brain and mutator gates of 32 §2 (B-02…B-10), measured as the prototype measured them (e1_sensitivity): genomes from texts (founders, control sentences, the neutral genome, contrast pairs, single edits) × the reference situations (15 §2), through the scene's real prompt and brain. Queries are built from texts only: nothing is registered in the world. Each writes a report (IntegrityReport).

files.Title: EvoSim.IntegrityReport
files.Summary: The result of one brain or mutator integrity check (32 §2): pass or fail, facts (models, digests or revisions, prompt ids, date), rows, written as JSON and Markdown under Logs/EvoSim/Reports so results compare over time.

files.Title: EvoSim.Intent
files.Summary: What an action wants this tick (ACT-03): a direction (or none: stay), walk or run, and the farthest it should go (to stop at a target). The locomotion decides what actually happens (MOVE-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.Interaction
files.Summary: The contact an action asks for on arrival (ACT-03, ACT-10): graze an item, strike an animal, eat a carcass portion or an egg, or a custom one. A small value, so planning allocates nothing.

files.Title: EvoSim.InteractionContext
files.Summary: What a custom interaction may use when it applies: the world, the ground, the actor's streams.

files.Title: EvoSim.InteractionKind
files.Summary: The contact effects of 07 §3 (ACT-11), plus custom ones.

files.Title: EvoSim.InteractionResolver
files.Summary: Applies the interactions of 07 §3 after moving (ACT-10, ACT-11): only within reach, only if the target is edible and the eater's diet lists it (SPEC-13). Hunters strike at most once per tick (ACT-12).

files.Title: EvoSim.JevBrain.SpeciesQuestion
files.Summary: The question asked for one species (the prototype asked predators "Which action does this predator take now?").

files.Title: EvoSim.JevBrain
files.Summary: JEV choice (08 §6): a distilled decision model behind vLLM. One /v1/completions request per batch with the list of texts, max_tokens 1, the option letters as the only allowed tokens and their log-probabilities; each row is softmax((log-prob + head bias) / T) with the head and T of the pinned revision. Options always in the species' action order; at most 16 (DEC-14); inputs above the training length are counted, not cut.

files.Title: EvoSim.JevHead
files.Summary: JEV's decision head and calibration at a pinned revision (08 §6): the option letters' token ids, a bias per slot, the temperature of the "choice" kind. Row = softmax((log-prob + bias) / T) over the options.

files.Title: EvoSim.KinematicLocomotion
files.Summary: The reference locomotion (MOVE-04): straight lines, no physics. Moves by the smallest of speed, stamina and the intent's maximum distance; slides along borders and obstacles; if stuck, takes a random sidestep.

files.Title: EvoSim.LevelSense
files.Summary: A stat as low, medium or high (ANIM-12): low < low threshold ≤ medium ≤ high threshold < high. Reference: energy 30 / 70, stamina prey 20 / 40, predators 10 / 20.

files.Title: EvoSim.Litter
files.Summary: Litter size and the energy babies cost (REPRO-10, REPRO-11): k uniform in [min, max], cut so that no parent pays more than it has, never below min; each baby starts with childEnergy, paid by the parents in equal shares.

files.Title: EvoSim.LiveStatistics.Point
files.Summary: One sample of one species.

files.Title: EvoSim.LiveStatistics
files.Summary: Time series for the editor's ecology monitor (21 §4, OUT-06): population, mean energy and stamina, births, deaths and memo hit rate per species, sampled every few ticks into fixed-size buffers.

files.Title: EvoSim.LlmMutation
files.Summary: The reference operator for text genes (10 §2): one instruction drawn from a deck, sent to the mutator with the sentence after one fixed context line, and nothing else (CORE-07, MUT-11). Every try's instruction and seed are drawn now (MUT-30); rejected answers are drawn again, up to tries (MUT-13).

files.Title: EvoSim.Locomotion
files.Summary: How a species moves (MOVE-01): it turns each animal's intent into movement, and whatever it does is the tick's result. Inherit it for terrain, NavMesh or physics movement (MOVE-07). Speeds are traits (MOVE-03).

files.Title: EvoSim.ManualPending
files.Summary: A pending completed by code: Wait() runs the given completion if it isn't done yet.

files.Title: EvoSim.MateAction
files.Summary: Walk to the nearest ready partner in sight, stopping at 1 m (07 §4). Breeding itself happens in the breed phase, never here (ACT-13).

files.Title: EvoSim.MatingRule
files.Summary: Who may breed and with whom (11 §1): an adult with enough energy is ready (REPRO-01); an animal that chose mate breeds with a ready partner within reach, whatever the partner chose (REPRO-02), once per decision period (REPRO-03).

files.Title: EvoSim.Metabolism
files.Summary: What a tick costs, once per living animal after it acted (ANIM-20), from the meters its locomotion reported, its action and whether it was busy (05 §4 reference table).

files.Title: EvoSim.MigrationPhase
files.Summary: Above its cap, a species loses animals chosen uniformly at random with its migration stream, ignoring genes, stats and position (POP-01, POP-02); animals born this tick are spared unless too few older ones remain.

files.Title: EvoSim.MoveContext
files.Summary: What a locomotion gets to move animals: the ground, the distance function, the streams, stamina budgets.

files.Title: EvoSim.MutationJob
files.Summary: One mutation of one gene of one baby (10 §1): its choices are drawn at conception (MUT-30); the result may come later, from the mutator (MUT-32). Succeeded → a new value; failed → the inherited allele stays (MUT-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.MutationOperator
files.Summary: A rule that changes one allele, blind to everything but the gene and the allele (CORE-07, 10 §1). Exactly one operator applies to a locus: the one configured for the gene, else the species' default for its kind (MUT-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.MutationStats
files.Summary: Mutation statistics of a run (MUT-05): attempts, successes, model calls, rejections by reason.

files.Title: EvoSim.MutationText
files.Summary: The LLM mutation's prompt, cleaning and guards (MUT-10…12), as the prototype does them (prototype/promptevo/evolution/mutation.py). Pure functions.

files.Title: EvoSim.MutatorClient
files.Summary: Sends prompts to the mutator model: Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible server in EvoSim.Http, a fake in tests. It never sees anything but the prompts (CORE-07).

files.Title: EvoSim.MutatorReply
files.Summary: The answers to a batch of mutator requests, filled later: an answer or an error per request.

files.Title: EvoSim.MutatorRequest
files.Summary: One prompt for the mutator model, with its seed and temperature (MUT-11, MUT-14).

files.Title: EvoSim.MutatorService
files.Summary: Runs LLM mutations (10 §2, §4): every try's instruction and seed are drawn at conception (MUT-30); requests are batched by round — all first tries together, then the redraws of the rejected ones (MUT-31); answers are cached by model, prompt, seed and temperature (MUT-14). It advances only when pumped on the main thread, so the Freeze and Responsive wait modes give the same results.

files.Title: EvoSim.NearestAnimalSense
files.Summary: The nearest animal of a set (threats, prey, kin, listed species), in bands (06 §4). With readiness on, a kin sense also says whether that animal is ready to mate, when it is within the partner range; beyond it readiness is unknown and not written. Hidden and killed animals are never reported (SENSE-06).

files.Title: EvoSim.NearestCoverSense
files.Summary: The nearest cover (06 §4): "here" when standing in cover, else the bands or none. Without a cover module it always says none (ENV-12). Reference label "Cover".

files.Title: EvoSim.NearestEntitySense
files.Summary: The nearest entity this animal may eat (06 §4): a carcass with portions left, not its own kill, not eaten from by it yet; or an egg its diet eats. Reference: the predator's "Carcass" sense.

files.Title: EvoSim.NearestResourceSense
files.Summary: The nearest item of a layer the species grazes (06 §4): here, the bands, none. Reference label "Food".

files.Title: EvoSim.NumberGene
files.Summary: A number expressed into one trait (GENE-04), e.g. a stamina gene setting stamina.max.

files.Title: EvoSim.Observation
files.Summary: The tuple of an animal's sense tokens at one decision, in sense order (SENSE-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.ObservationSet.Row
files.Summary: One situation: tokens by sense label, plus its source and tags.

files.Title: EvoSim.ObservationSet
files.Summary: A fixed list of situations, written by sense label and token (15 §2, "the 48 situations"): the prototype's rows ({"energy": "low", "food": "close", "animal": "adjacent", "animal_ready": true, …}) are matched to a species' senses by label; a sense the row doesn't name takes a default token.

files.Title: EvoSim.ObservationView
files.Summary: An observation read through its species' senses: the token of a sense by label (CTRL-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.OldAge
files.Summary: Death of old age: age above the maximum (reference 1 500 ticks; ANIM-40).

files.Title: EvoSim.OllamaMutatorClient
files.Summary: The reference mutator (10 §2): a model in Ollama on the CPU (gemma4:26b, owner 2026-10-10; num_gpu 0, num_ctx 1 024), thinking off, so the GPU stays JEV's.

files.Title: EvoSim.OllamaPointsBrain
files.Summary: LLM, points mode (08 §6): one Ollama chat call per distinct query; the prompt ends with the points instruction, the answer is constrained by a JSON schema, temperature 0, a fixed seed, a fixed context length, thinking off; points become a row by DEC-41.

files.Title: EvoSim.OllamaTags
files.Summary: Reads a model's digest from Ollama's /api/tags (first 12 characters), for cache keys and run info (DEC-33, GENE-12).

files.Title: EvoSim.OpenAIMutatorClient
files.Summary: A mutator behind an OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, docker profile gpu-mutator): /v1/chat/completions with the seed and temperature, thinking off through chat_template_kwargs.

files.Title: EvoSim.Ownership
files.Summary: Who owns which module (ARCH-05, ARCH-06): the nearest owner above it; disabled means absent.

files.Title: EvoSim.Pending
files.Summary: Work a phase waits for: brain answers, mutations (TICK-03, SPACE-13).

files.Title: EvoSim.PlayerArgs
files.Summary: A watched run's settings from a command line (the Windows player): -scene name, -seed n, -ticks n, -minutes m (wall clock), -speed (ticks per second | fast | fixed), -wait (responsive | freeze), -brain (a brain's GameObject name or id), -capture seconds (0 = start and end only, off = none), -cache folder, -run folder name, -noMutation, -quitAtEnd, -window WIDTHxHEIGHT (a window of that many pixels), -stagger (every species decides staggered, DEC-04). Parsing and applying are separate, so tests check both without a player.

files.Title: EvoSim.PlayerLauncher
files.Summary: In a player (not the editor), reads the command line () and sets each World before it starts (). With -scene, a World of another scene doesn't start and that scene loads instead. With -quitAtEnd, the player quits once the run stopped and its captures are written. Run files, captures and the answer cache land next to the build (paths are relative to its folder).

files.Title: EvoSim.PointsAnswer
files.Summary: Points answers to rows (DEC-41): a missing action counts 0, negative points count 0, every action gets +0.01, then the row is normalised, so an all-zero answer becomes uniform. An answer that isn't a JSON object, or points that aren't numbers, are failures (as the prototype's int() raised).

files.Title: EvoSim.PromptTemplate
files.Summary: A species' prompt with three holes: {genes}, {situation}, {ask} (PROMPT-01, PROMPT-04). Its id is a hash of this text, so any change to a header, an action line or a rule changes the id and the cache key (PROMPT-05).

files.Title: EvoSim.PromptWriter
files.Summary: Collects the action lines and rule lines that modules contribute to a species' prompt (PROMPT-01). Numbers in rule lines come from placeholders filled from module settings (PROMPT-03): {field} on the writing module, {Module.field} on another module of the species, {species.Module.field} on a module of another species; {name} and {species.name} are display names. A placeholder reads a field or a property; {{ and }} write a brace. A module is named by its class, a base class, or its GameObject.

files.Title: EvoSim.PrototypeFormat
files.Summary: The Python prototype's file conventions, for the recorder's compatibility mode (OUT-05): its two species were "the agents" and the predators, it logged kills as "predator" and prefixed predator statistics with "pred_".

files.Title: EvoSim.QuitWhenStopped
files.Summary: Quits the player once its World stopped and the captures are written (-quitAtEnd).

files.Title: EvoSim.RandomBrain
files.Summary: Uniform over the species' actions, whatever the genes and the situation: the null model (08 §6).

files.Title: EvoSim.RandomStream
files.Summary: One named random stream: a PCG32 generator seeded from SHA-256 of the seed and the name (RAND-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.RandomStreams
files.Summary: The named random streams of one world (RAND-02…04). Asking twice for a name returns the same stream. Map layers use "world/<layer name>", so adding a layer never changes another layer's map.

files.Title: EvoSim.RayBatch
files.Summary: The rays of all deciding animals of a sense phase, cast in one batch (SENSE-30) with RaycastCommand, or one at a time with Physics.Raycast (Immediate, for comparison: SENSE-31). Version-specific physics code lives here (ARCH-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.RecordPhase
files.Summary: A statistics row every statsEvery ticks and the periodic flushes (TICK-04 #11, RAND-22); live statistics for the editor.

files.Title: EvoSim.RecordingTransport
files.Summary: Wraps a transport and keeps every request body and answer, for integrity checks that inspect what a model received (B-11). The API key is passed through and never kept (OUT-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.RequiresModuleAttribute
files.Summary: Names a module this one needs beside it (a drink needs thirst): a species module on the same species, or a world module (a service or a phase) under the World. Validation reports a missing one (V-26) with a fix that adds it, and the conformance suites add it before testing the module.

files.Title: EvoSim.ResourceItem
files.Summary: One item of a resource layer found by a query: its layer, cell, position and distance (ENV-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.ResourceLayer
files.Summary: Edible items spread over the ground, e.g. grass (03 §1). The layer's says how it is eaten; diets name the layer by its GameObject's name.

files.Title: EvoSim.RestAction
files.Summary: Stay still to catch your breath and save energy (07 §4). Never searches; the metabolism charges its rest cost.

files.Title: EvoSim.RunCapture
files.Summary: Saves what the screen shows (overlay included): a PNG when the run starts, every few seconds of real time, and when it stops, into <folder>/<run>/ (the run recorder's folder name), then a contact sheet of them. PNGs are encoded off the main thread. It only reads the World and draws no random numbers (RAND-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.RunInfo
files.Summary: What ran (13 §2, CFG-03): the scene, the full effective configuration by path, git commit, Unity version, brains and mutator (models, hosts), seeds, wait mode, act order and controls. Never any secret (OUT-04).

files.Title: EvoSim.RunNumbers.SpeciesLine
files.Summary: One species' line of the overlay.

files.Title: EvoSim.RunNumbers
files.Summary: What the overlay shows of a run, read from the World's own counters (13 §4–5) and nothing else: tick, state, population, births, deaths, kills, mutations, model calls. Read only; a test compares it with the event log.

files.Title: EvoSim.RunOverlay
files.Summary: The run's numbers on screen, in the editor and in a build (immediate-mode GUI): tick, state and what the tick waits for, ticks per second achieved against the target, frames per second, each species' population, births and deaths, mutations, model calls; and the followed animal's action, stats and genes (). It only reads the World (). Tab hides it.

files.Title: EvoSim.RunRecorder
files.Summary: Writes a run into its own folder (13): events.jsonl, stats.csv, alleles.jsonl, final_population.json, summary.json, run_info.json. Events and stats are flushed every 500 ticks, alleles every 5 000 (RAND-22), and every file is written when the run stops, whatever the reason (RAND-20). The compatibility mode writes a two-species world exactly as the prototype does (OUT-05).

files.Title: EvoSim.RunSpeed
files.Summary: How fast a running world advances (02 §4, run controls). Results never depend on it (SPACE-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.RunState
files.Summary: The World's run loop states (brief, chapter B §13).

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.ChasedSense
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §13: whether the nearest threat is hunting this animal — its target at the start of the tick (SENSE-04). Lets a cannibal tell a hungry neighbour from a peaceful one.

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.DiesOfThirst
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §1: thirst grows in the death phase, and an animal at the deadly level dies of "thirst".

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.DragAction
files.Summary: Scenario S18 (ENV-21): walk to the nearest carcass in sight, then drag it 1 m per tick toward the nearest cover. The carcass moves in the act phase through an interaction, never from the visuals.

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.DrinkAction
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §3: walk to the nearest visible water's shore and drink there, which resets thirst.

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.IntensityLadder
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §8 (MUT-21): a rule-based text operator that moves the sentence's intensity word one step along never, rarely, sometimes, often, always — no model. It sees only the gene and its stream (MUT-30).

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.NearestWaterSense
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §2: how far the nearest water is, in bands, with "here" at the shore (a query the ground offers).

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.SeasonsPhase
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §9: a phase before Environment that slows the grass's regrowth in the second half of every year.

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.SlopeLocomotion
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §14: the kinematic locomotion that refuses ground steeper than a limit and charges energy for every meter climbed (MOVE-02 still holds: it only moves the animal through Move).

files.Title: EvoSim.Samples.Thirst
files.Summary: Recipe 22 §1: a thirst stat that grows every tick (with DiesOfThirst) and kills at a threshold.

files.Title: EvoSim.Sampling
files.Summary: Sampling temperature (DEC-20): p^(1/τ), renormalised; τ < 1 sharpens, τ > 1 flattens. Pure functions.

files.Title: EvoSim.ScenarioAsset.Override
files.Summary: One setting to override: a path and its new value, as text.

files.Title: EvoSim.ScenarioAsset.Variant
files.Summary: A variant of the scenario: its own brain, tier, overrides and removed GameObjects, on top of the scenario's.

files.Title: EvoSim.ScenarioAsset
files.Summary: A scenario (31 §1, CFG-02): a scene plus overrides by path, variants, seeds, a length, a brain and the expected facts. The scenario runner window and EvoSim.Batch.RunScenario read it.

files.Title: EvoSim.SearchRule
files.Summary: The prompt's search rule (PROMPT-01): what an animal does when its action has nothing to act on (ACT-04). Put it on the species' own GameObject so it comes first among the rule lines.

files.Title: EvoSim.Secrets
files.Summary: What a key, token or password looks like (OUT-04): one rule for validation (V-61, every serialized string of the World), the HTTP checks and the command line written to run_info.json.

files.Title: EvoSim.Sense
files.Summary: Reads one animal and the world and returns one token from a fixed list (SENSE-01): what the brain is told about one aspect of the situation, such as the nearest food or the energy level.

files.Title: EvoSim.SenseContext
files.Summary: What a sense may read at a decision: the world state at the start of the tick (SENSE-04), through the same queries as actions, so hidden and killed animals are never reported (SENSE-06).

files.Title: EvoSim.SensePhase
files.Summary: Picks who decides (DEC-01): every living, not busy animal on the decision ticks, and animals without an action on the others; rebuilds the spatial index; casts the rays of batched senses in one batch; reads every sense of every deciding animal from the state at the start of the tick (TICK-04 #1, SENSE-04, TICK-05).

files.Title: EvoSim.SentenceGuards
files.Summary: The checks a gene sentence must pass, founder or mutant (MUT-12, GENE-22). Pure functions.

files.Title: EvoSim.Severity
files.Summary: How serious a validation message is (21 §2): an error (E) blocks Play and the run; a warning (W) and an information (I) don't.

files.Title: EvoSim.SimEvent
files.Summary: One logged fact (OUT-02): kind, tick, animal id, species, and more fields. Keys are written sorted.

files.Title: EvoSim.SpatialIndex
files.Summary: Animals by species in a uniform hash grid (20 §3.11, SENSE-32): rebuilt by the sense and act phases, updated as animals move in a sequential act order. Nearest queries search expanding rings and break ties by id (SPACE-07, SPACE-08). The ring bound assumes the world distance is at least the horizontal Euclidean one.

files.Title: EvoSim.Species
files.Summary: A kind of animal (SPEC-01, SPEC-02). Configure it with child components; subclass it only for hooks.

files.Title: EvoSim.SpeciesBuilder.Problem
files.Summary: A declaration problem, reported by validation: V-36 (a default outside its range), V-38 (declared twice differently).

files.Title: EvoSim.SpeciesBuilder.StatDeclaration
files.Summary: One declared stat, with the module that declared it (for the species inspector).

files.Title: EvoSim.SpeciesBuilder.TraitDeclaration
files.Summary: One declared trait, with the module that declared it.

files.Title: EvoSim.SpeciesBuilder
files.Summary: Collects the stats and traits a species' modules declare before any animal exists (ANIM-10, ANIM-15).

files.Title: EvoSim.SpeciesCounters
files.Summary: Cumulative counts of one species for the statistics rows and the summary (13 §4, §5).

files.Title: EvoSim.SpeciesModule
files.Summary: A component under a species: a gene, a sense, an action, a stat, a rule...

files.Title: EvoSim.Stamina
files.Summary: Stamina: the meters an animal can move before it must stop (05 §4). Each meter moved costs one point; standing still brings it back, which costs some energy until it is full (ANIM-21).

files.Title: EvoSim.Starvation
files.Summary: Death by starvation: energy ≤ 0 at the death check (ANIM-40).

files.Title: EvoSim.StatId
files.Summary: A handle to a declared stat (ANIM-10): its slot in the animal record, its name and its range.

files.Title: EvoSim.StatStart
files.Summary: The value a stat takes when an animal is created (ANIM-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.SystemHttpTransport
files.Summary: The real transport: an HttpClient owned by one brain or mutator client (ARCH-07: nothing shared between worlds), every await with ConfigureAwait(false) so answers never need the main thread (the Freeze mode blocks it, SPACE-14). Time-outs come from the caller (DEC-42).

files.Title: EvoSim.TerrainGround
files.Summary: A Unity Terrain as ground (02 §1): heights from the heightmap; walkable above the water level, below a maximum steepness, outside tree footprints; only the largest connected walkable region is kept (SPACE-05). Walkability is computed once, on a grid of cells.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.AdvancePending
files.Summary: A wait that ends after a number of calls: how the test fakes answer late (30 §2). In the Freeze wait mode the World calls , which ends it at once.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.AllLayersObstacleSense
files.Summary: A test batched sense that asks for its ray against every physics layer: even so, the views' layer is left out, so what is rendered never changes what animals sense (RAND-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.AllocationProbe
files.Summary: A test phase placed just before and just after another phase: the pair measures the bytes the main thread allocated in between, every tick (R-07: no allocation per tick in the act phase after warm-up).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.BatchProbeAction
files.Summary: A test-only action that wanders and records the group sizes the act phase plans through ActAll (ARCH-12, 20 §10).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.BatchProbeLocomotion
files.Summary: A test-only locomotion that records the group sizes the act phase moves through MoveAll (ARCH-12, 20 §10).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.BatchProbeSense
files.Summary: A test-only sense that records the group sizes the sense phase reads through ReadAll (ARCH-12, 20 §10).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Blackboard
files.Summary: Shared state for test phases that change "the world" and read it (T-TICK-02): one blackboard is given to several s, to see which phases see a change.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.BlackboardPhase
files.Summary: A test phase that reads the blackboard (logging what it sees), then optionally writes it: only the phases after a writer see the new value in the same tick (T-TICK-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.CallbackPhase
files.Summary: A test-only phase that runs a callback at its place in the tick (to look at the state between two phases).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.CameraProbeSense
files.Summary: A test sense that attaches an "image" (a byte array) to every query, with no cache key unless asked (T-SENSE-10, S24): such queries are never memoised or cached (SENSE-41), and a brain that takes no attachments fails validation (V-51).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.CountingCrossover
files.Summary: A test-only uniform crossover that counts its calls (GENE-32: one cross per baby).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.DelayedPhase
files.Summary: A test phase that waits, every ticks, for an answer that arrives Advance calls after it was asked (like a slow brain); in Freeze mode Wait() delivers it at once.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.DoubleDistanceGround
files.Summary: A flat ground whose distance function is twice the Euclidean one: a replaced distance, which every sense and action must then use (T-SPACE-02, SPACE-06).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ExerciseProbe
files.Summary: A finished teaching-path exercise (22 §0) for the Exercises menu tests: a litter that keeps the reference's rule. Its name is not MyLitter, so the menu never takes it for a student's stub.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.FakeHttpTransport
files.Summary: A fake server for HTTP brains and mutators (30 §2): answers each request with a scripted function, records every request, can fail, hang until the time-out, or answer late; counts requests in flight at once.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.FakeMutator
files.Summary: A test mutator client (30 §2): answers mutation prompts with a scripted function (by default it appends "quickly" to the sentence), records every prompt and batch, and can answer N Advance calls late or fail.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.FeedAction
files.Summary: A test-only action: stay, and eat a snack of through a custom interaction that feeds the animal with (a meal counted like any other).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Fruit
files.Summary: A test-only entity of a kind of one's own: a fruit.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.FruitSystem
files.Summary: A test-only entity system for fruit: nothing moves or rots. Several systems of one kind can live in a world ("Apples", "Pears"), and actions find their entities with NearestEntity<Fruit>.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.GoToAction
files.Summary: A test action that walks or runs toward a fixed point, stopping at a distance (T-SPACE-01, T-MOVE-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Golden
files.Summary: Golden files under Assets/EvoSim/Tests/Golden/ (30 §2): situation texts, prompts, hashes. A missing file is written from the current output (pinned from the first accepted run); an existing one must match exactly. Re-pinning is a deliberate commit that deletes or edits the file and says why.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.HookProbe
files.Summary: A test-only species module that counts the births and deaths it hears and adds two statistics columns (probe_born, probe_died, written with the species' prefix in stats.csv).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.InvariantPhase
files.Summary: A last phase for test worlds: fails the test on the first broken invariant (30 §5).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Invariants
files.Summary: The checks run after every tick in test worlds (30 §5): positions inside and walkable, no NaN, stats in range, unique ids, no dead or killed animal left, valid actions and rows, populations between floor and cap, carcass portions ≥ 0, genomes of the right length and species.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Lab
files.Summary: The Lab 1 reference species and world as ready-made recipes for tests (04 §5, 08 §7, 09 §3, 14 §2): prey (eat, flee, hide, follow, rest, mate) and predator (hunt, follow, rest, mate) with the prototype's values, founder pools, contrast pairs and prompt texts.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.MemoryBrain
files.Summary: A test-only brain with memory: not memoizable, so every deciding animal's query reaches it with its id (even animals in the same situation), and it answers uniform rows.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.NeedsEnergyProbe
files.Summary: A test-only module that names a companion it needs with : a species without an module gets the warning V-26, whose fix adds one.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ObstacleSense
files.Summary: A test batched sense: one ray along the heading; "blocked" if it hits a collider within 5 m (T-SENSE-09).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.OverlayProbeAction
files.Summary: A test-only overlay (ACT-07): done in passing, it plans a walk that must be ignored and a custom interaction that counts the times it applied, per animal.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Place
files.Summary: Puts animals, food items, cover and carcasses at exact positions in a built world (30 §2), so a test sets up the very situation it checks. Records no event.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.PondGround
files.Summary: A test ground: flat, with a round pond (not walkable) whose shore animals can reach (samples 22 §2–§3). It answers the water queries that the water sense and the drink action ask.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ProbeAction
files.Summary: A test-only action defined outside the runtime assembly (T-CORE-02): it counts its calls and stays.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ProbeSense
files.Summary: A test-only sense with two tokens; it returns the animal's id parity (T-CORE-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.RampGround
files.Summary: A test ground: flat for x < RampStart, then a ramp rising at RampSlope (height per meter) (T-MOVE-07).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.RandomEventPhase
files.Summary: A test phase that draws from a named stream every tick and records a "probe" event, so the hash depends on the draws.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ScriptedBrain
files.Summary: A test brain (30 §2): answers from a policy written in the test, or from given rows per (species, observation); counts calls and batches; can answer N Advance calls late, fail, or refuse to mix species. Test code only: the system ships no rule-based brain (owner decision).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ShowProbeView
files.Summary: A test-only view that remembers what OnShow told it.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.SideCover
files.Summary: A test-only cover: every point with x in [MinX, MaxX] is in cover. Several covers in one world combine (ENV-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.SlopeLimitLocomotion
files.Summary: A kinematic locomotion that refuses slopes steeper than a limit (T-MOVE-07, after 22 §14).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.SnapshotPhase
files.Summary: A test phase that keeps every living animal's genome texts at the end of each tick (T-OUT-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.SourceScan
files.Summary: Reads the EvoSim source files for static checks (T-RAND-01, T-CORE-08, T-ACT-09): comments removed, line numbers kept.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.SpeciesSetup
files.Summary: Adds modules to one species of a world being built: what hands to its configure callback.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.Stat
files.Summary: Statistical asserts: a proportion or a mean within k standard errors, a χ² uniformity test (30 §2).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.SureKillDiet
files.Summary: A test-only diet: every strike kills, and every meal gives exactly energy.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.ThrowingPhase
files.Summary: A test phase that throws, for the RAND-20 test: the World stops the run cleanly ("exception in ThrowingPhase") and lets the exception through.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.TracePhase
files.Summary: A test phase that writes "tick:name" to a log each time it runs (T-TICK-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.TraitProbe
files.Summary: A test module declaring one trait (default 60, range [1, 120]) and one capped stat (T-ANIM-02, T-ANIM-03).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.TurningLocomotion
files.Summary: A test locomotion that ignores the intent's direction: it turns it by 30° and halves the distance (T-MOVE-06).

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.WorldBuilder
files.Summary: Builds a world in code, with no scene (30 §2): ground, food, cover, services, phases and species, each added by one chained call, then .

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.WorldFixture
files.Summary: The base class of tests that build worlds: every world started with is destroyed after each test, so tests leave nothing in the scene.

files.Title: EvoSim.Testing.WorldHookProbe
files.Summary: A test-only world service that counts every species' births and deaths and adds one statistics column (world_born, after the species' columns in stats.csv).

files.Title: EvoSim.TextGene
files.Summary: A sentence the brain reads in the genes block of the prompt (GENE-03, PROMPT-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.TextStyle
files.Summary: The style of situation texts (SENSE-11): V1 terse ("Energy: low."), V2 first person ("I am hungry and weak.").

files.Title: EvoSim.TickContext
files.Summary: What a phase gets each tick: the world, the tick number and the named streams.

files.Title: EvoSim.TickPhase
files.Summary: One step of a tick. The World runs its phases in hierarchy order (TICK-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.TraitId
files.Summary: A handle to a declared trait (ANIM-15): a per-animal number fixed at birth, with a default and a range.

files.Title: EvoSim.UniformCrossover
files.Summary: For each locus independently, the allele of one parent or the other with probability ½ (GENE-30).

files.Title: EvoSim.Units
files.Summary: Units of the simulation: meters on the horizontal plane, ticks for time (README, Units).

files.Title: EvoSim.ValidationFix
files.Summary: A fix button for a validation message (EDIT-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.ValidationMessage
files.Summary: One problem, naming the object at fault (EDIT-02).

files.Title: EvoSim.ValidationReport
files.Summary: The messages of one validation pass. The same engine runs in the editor, at Initialize and in CI (EDIT-01).

files.Title: EvoSim.ValueNoise
files.Summary: Value noise on a lattice: random values at lattice points, smoothly interpolated (the prototype's cover and terrain maps). A noise map is built once from a stream; sampling it is a pure function.

files.Title: EvoSim.ViewPool
files.Summary: Inactive views of one species, reused (20 §6): a new animal takes one, a dead one gives it back. Views have no active collider and sit on the "Ignore Raycast" layer, which every sense ray leaves out, so what the animals sense never depends on rendering (SPACE-12, RAND-11).

files.Title: EvoSim.WaitMode
files.Summary: How a tick waits for brain answers and mutations (SPACE-14). Both give the same events hash.

files.Title: EvoSim.WaterHit
files.Summary: The nearest water found by a ground: the water point, a walkable shore point next to it, the distance.

files.Title: EvoSim.World
files.Summary: The root of a simulation (01 §3): finds its species, phases and services in its subtree, initialises them in a fixed order (ARCH-04, 20 §4) and runs ticks. FixedUpdate only drives the loop; time is Tick (SPACE-10).

files.Title: EvoSim.WorldCamera
files.Summary: A camera for watching a run: it frames the world at the start; WASD or the arrows pan, the wheel zooms, the right mouse button (or Q and E) orbits, the middle button drags, F frames the world again. A left click on an animal follows it (Esc stops). Picking is done on screen, from the views' positions: views have no colliders (SPACE-12), and the camera only reads the World.

files.Title: EvoSim.WorldModule
files.Summary: A component under the World (not under a species): a phase or a service.

files.Title: EvoSim.WorldQueries
files.Summary: The queries senses and actions share (ACT-05, SENSE-06): within the animal's vision, never itself, never a killed animal, never an animal hidden from it in cover, diets checked. Ties by id (SPACE-08).

files.Title: EvoSim.WorldService
files.Summary: Something phases and modules use: ground, layers, brains, recorder. Found with World.Service<T>().
